setup: [a seller on a marketplace or a social media page offers concert tickets or a sold-out gadget at a fair price, with good reviews and photos] [the seller says only a few are left and other buyers are waiting]
ask: [the seller asks for a deposit now to hold the item, paid to a personal account or through a checkout link instead of the marketplace's own checkout, with delivery weeks away]
usualEnding: The deposit goes, the delivery date keeps moving, then the seller asks for the balance or a shipping fee and disappears.
realTwin: A real seller on the marketplace offers to meet in a public place so the player can see the item first, or to sell through the marketplace's own checkout.

source.url: https://www.scamshield.gov.sg/i-want-protection-from-scams/learn-to-recognise-scams/e-commerce-scams/ (updated 26 May 2026: payment outside the platform's checkout, a limited-time price, links sent by the seller); SPF Mid-Year Scam and Cybercrime Brief 2026 (pre-order deposits lead e-commerce cases) and the HK Government 2025 law and order release of 11 Feb 2026 (concert-ticket fraud up 61.8%), both cited in docs/scam-realism-2026.md.
